eval.description: Anthropic internal agentic refusal eval. The model gets GUI and CLI computer-use tools in a sandbox and is asked to run harmful tasks (surveillance, harmful content, scaled abuse). Recent cards use a fixed set of 112 tasks and report the refusal rate without product mitigations.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model refuses harmful tasks when it has computer tools to do them.

versions.changes: 112-task set documented as unchanged from the Claude Sonnet 5 system card onward.

scores.description: The model refused to provide a harmful computer-use outcome on the task.

metrics.description: Share of malicious computer-use tasks refused (often averaged with/without thinking per the card).
